question: In a certain code language, if TOGETHER is coded as 'TOERGETH' and TOMORROW is coded as 'TOOWMORR', then what will BATHROOM be coded as?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c862ea9c33a633c54bfcf4c329c66d9a52118504f28cbfbfdf760e12f52cc05.png] 

The logic followed here is:

TOGETHER is coded as 'TOERGETH'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9df15994f20e1ad556eb297b05bc466cd8ebb9fc1b5bd9ddf89fa04a3f3a1a53.png] 

TOMORROW is coded as 'TOOWMORR',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33c8fda6ec05aac5e9c2eae9af0fc8671b38a6592063eef3b83869b53c17fe29.png] 

Similarly, **BATHROOM **will be coded:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be59f20f2ec2c52f257a92eba4f23a2f261c90f1ac412bcfdc3ee18e333ee1f7.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"BAOMTHRO".**
